title: A Hybrid Two-Stage Machine Learning Pipeline for Fault Detection and Classification in Power Transmission Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.23726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid and accurate fault detection in high-voltage transmission networks is essential for grid reliability and equipment protection. Transmission fault datasets are frequently imbalanced, and certain fault types produce electrical signatures that fall within the normal operating envelope, causing single-model classifiers to fail on safety-critical cases. This paper proposes a hybrid two-stage machine learning pipeline that decouples detection from classification. Stage 1 combines an Isolation Forest anomaly detector with an optional supervised binary detector through an OR-fusion rule; the supervised branch is allocated automatically during training for any fault class the anomaly detector cannot resolve, and is omitted when no such class exists. Stage 2 applies a Random Forest multiclass classifier only to samples flagged by Stage 1. Feature engineering is expressed as a per-measurement-point operator mapping six raw channels to eight

translated_title: 一种用于输电系统故障检测与分类的混合两阶段机器学习流水线
translated_abstract: 高压输电网络中快速准确的故障检测对于电网可靠性和设备保护至关重要。输电故障数据集通常不平衡，且某些故障类型产生的电气特征落在正常运行包络内，导致单一模型分类器在安全关键情况下失效。本文提出了一种混合两阶段机器学习流水线，将检测与分类解耦。第一阶段结合隔离森林异常检测器与可选的监督二元检测器，通过OR融合规则实现；监督分支在训练过程中自动分配给任何异常检测器无法解决的故障类别，并在不存在此类类别时省略。第二阶段仅对第一阶段标记的样本应用随机森林多类分类器。特征工程表示为每个测量点的算子映射，将六个原始通道转换为八个特征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种混合两阶段机器学习流水线，通过解耦检测与分类，结合隔离森林和随机森林，有效处理不平衡数据及安全关键故障，提升输电系统故障检测的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid two-stage machine learning pipeline that decouples detection from classification, combining Isolation Forest and Random Forest to handle imbalanced data and safety-critical faults, improving fault detection reliability in power transmission systems.
